_docs.overview: Affiliate link registry for AIfocus. This file controls ALL outbound affiliate links across the entire site.
_docs.how_it_works: Every 'Try [Product]' button and affiliate link on the site points to /go/[slug]/, which redirects visitors to the 'destination' URL below. To start earning commissions, replace each placeholder destination with your real affiliate tracking URL.
how_to_update: 1. Sign up for the affiliate program listed in each link's 'network' field (see 'signup_urls' below)
2. Once approved, copy your unique affiliate/tracking URL from the network dashboard
3. Replace the 'destination' value for that product with your real tracking URL
4. Save this file and rebuild the site (npm run build)
5. Test by visiting /go/[slug]/ — it should redirect to your affiliate URL

field_reference.slug: URL identifier — must match the affiliateSlug in products.json (do not change)
field_reference.name: Product display name — for your reference only (does not appear on site)
field_reference.destination: The URL visitors are redirected to — REPLACE with your real affiliate tracking URL
field_reference.network: Which affiliate network or program manages this link (for your reference). 'none' means the tool has no public affiliate program, so the link stays as a standard referral link.
field_reference.placeholder: true = this link still uses a placeholder URL and needs your real tracking link. false = final URL (either a real tracking URL, or a standard link for a tool with no program)
field_reference.active: true = link is live on the site, false = link is disabled (button still shows but goes nowhere)

signup_urls.impact: https://app.impact.com — Grammarly and Otter.ai affiliate programs
signup_urls.partnerstack: https://market.partnerstack.com — Consensus and QuillBot affiliate programs
signup_urls.submagic: https://www.submagic.co/affiliate — Submagic in-house affiliate program (already live with your tracking link)
signup_urls.none: No public affiliate program — ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, Midjourney, GitHub Copilot and Elicit do not offer one (Elicit's closed in 2025). These links stay as standard referral links and earn nothing; that is expected, not a setup gap.

important_notes: All affiliate links on the site automatically include rel='nofollow sponsored' for compliance
The /go/ redirect pages are excluded from search engines via robots.txt and noindex tags
You can disable any product's affiliate link by setting 'active' to false
After updating, always test each link to confirm it redirects correctly
Submagic is already earning — its link uses your live tracking URL (via=alan83), so commissions start as soon as visitors click through and subscribe.
Six more tools earn commission once their tracking URLs are added (network: impact, partnerstack, shareasale, dub.co). The five with network 'none' have no program and remain standard links.
